*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
**[[Iran]] parades disinfection vehicles, mobile hospitals, and other medical equipment to mark [[Islamic Republic of Iran Army Day|Army Day]] as their death toll rose to 4,598. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-iran-idUSKBN21Z0YW (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]], [[economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**Hundreds of [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment workers]] march in [[Chittagong]], [[Bangladesh]], demanding factory owners pay them last month's wages following delays. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-southasia/bangladesh-garment-workers-pack-streets-to-demand-wages-during-coronavirus-lockdown-idUSKBN2200OJ?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
***[[Taiwan]] quarantines 700 [[Republic of China Navy|Navy]] sailors after three cases of [[COVID-19]] were confirmed on board a vessel that recently returned from the island nation of [[Palau]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-taiwan/taiwan-to-quarantine-700-navy-sailors-after-virus-outbreak-idUSKBN2200BQ?il=0 (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 5,526 new confirmed cases and 888 more deaths from COVID-19, bringing the [[United Kingdom]]'s death toll to 15,464 and 114,217 total cases. [https://www.rte.ie/news/2020/0418/1132339-uk-coronavirus-death-toll/ (RTÉ)]

;International relations
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]], [[Pakistan–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**[[Pakistan]] begins repatriating some of [[Pakistanis in the United Arab Emirates|its citizens]] from the [[United Arab Emirates]], after the UAE threatened to review its labor ties with countries that refuse to take their nationals back during the pandemic. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-emirates/pakistan-starts-repatriating-uae-based-nationals-stranded-by-coronavirus-idUSKBN22107J?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*Forty-four suspected [[Boko Haram]] members are found dead, apparently due to poisoning, inside a prison in [[N'Djamena]], [[Chad]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/18/44-suspected-boko-haram-members-found-dead-in-chad-prison (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons]]
**[[Bonanno crime family]] mobster [[Vincent Asaro]] is granted [[compassionate release]] and released from the [[United States Medical Center for Federal Prisoners]] in [[Missouri]] due to the coronavirus pandemic. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/04/18/us/vincent-asaro-released-trnd/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2019–20 Hong Kong protests]]
**Convener of the [[Civil Human Rights Front]] of [[Hong Kong]], [[Jimmy Sham]], warns police to expect "more resistance than ever" as veteran pro-democracy activists are arrested in a mass raid. Sham also says plans for a mass rally on July 1 are underway. [https://news.rthk.hk/rthk/en/component/k2/1521343-20200418.htm (Radio Television Hong Kong)]
**Vice-convener of Sham's organization, Figo Chan, is also arrested Saturday afternoon by Hong Kong police. [https://hongkongfp.com/2020/04/18/8-hong-kong-pro-democracy-figures-arrested-in-latest-police-round-up-party-says/ (Hong Kong Free Press)]
